decisions.subject: Generic new-target effective-applicability snapshot producer
decisions.reason: EMS defines required inputs/outcomes, but Hayes has only frozen/scoped applicability consumers; choosing a generalized engine versus a thin onboarding adapter changes public architecture.

decisions.subject: Onboarding assessment-plan/bundle contract boundary
decisions.reason: Existing evaluator request/result contract should remain stable; EMS requires additional immutable plan and bundle artifacts, but their standalone versus additive contract placement is not determined.

decisions.subject: Unified human-review derived-artifact persistence
decisions.reason: EMS requires non-mutating review resolution, but current Hayes has applicability-only review artifacts and no canonical onboarding storage contract.

decisions.subject: Identity allocation boundary
decisions.reason: EMS Governance allocates IDs; Hayes consumes an approved identity and must not allocate it.

decisions.subject: Local execution path boundary
decisions.reason: Local paths are execution-only and non-authoritative.

decisions.subject: Batch runtime reuse after plan freeze
decisions.reason: create_wave2d_batch_run.py and scoped request builder can execute once onboarding inputs are frozen.
